title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender Superdrop

paragraphs.text: The Avatar: The Last Airbender Superdrop is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on November 17, 2025.
Avatar: The Last Airbender Superdrop was released in the context of the main Avatar: The Last Airbender set release and features additional references to the original animated series .
Customers receive a foil Path of Ancestry Secret Lair Promo with art by Takeuchi Moto, for each $199 spent on Avatar: The Last Airbender Superdrop products.
As an extra, each drop comes with a random bonus card from several options.
